title: Execution Envelope v1
description: Frozen execution contract (SW-1510-CONTRACT). Service-authorized execution budget for one run, carrying one of two explicit policies. 'observe_adapt' records atomic counters and applies only per-request limits and active-slot caps; it has no cumulative USD/token/request ceiling and no whole-job deadline (deadline_utc is a scheduling target, or null, and never aborts productive work). 'enforcing' is an explicit opt-in whose cumulative ceilings and deadline flag are stated in the envelope and abort when reached. Unknown usage is recorded as unknown and remains reserved; it is never counted as zero. authorized_principal and authority_evidence_digest come from the owner authority, not a worker claim.

authorized_principal.description: Owner principal that granted the envelope. Authenticated at the service seam, not self-declared by the worker.

deadline_utc.description: Scheduling target, or null when there is none. It is a hard abort deadline ONLY when limit_policy.policy is 'enforcing' and limit_policy.enforcement.deadline is true. Under 'observe_adapt' it never aborts productive work, and null is an honest 'no deadline' value, never a fabricated future date.

max_request_bytes.description: Per-request pre-flight exposure reservation in raw request bytes.

max_inflight_requests.description: Active-slot cap for live HTTP capacity.

counters.description: Optional atomic accounting counters. These are measurements, not completion-stopping ceilings; when omitted there is simply no accounting ceiling. No invented positive maximum is required.

max_requests.description: Nonnegative atomic request counter. Measurement only under observe_adapt.

max_reserved_tokens.description: Nonnegative atomic token-reservation counter. Measurement only under observe_adapt.

max_requests.description: Explicit cumulative request ceiling that aborts when reached.

max_reserved_tokens.description: Explicit cumulative token ceiling that aborts when reached.

max_correction_rounds.description: Zero correction rounds is a valid finite choice; unbounded retry has no representation here.

deadline.description: When true, deadline_utc must be a real timestamp and aborts when reached.

allowed_routes.description: Exhaustively admitted routes. No implicit client fallback outside this list.
